task_description: Build a modern enterprise-grade fullstack web platform named 'Karya Kreatif Andalan' for car rental and electric motorcycle rental services focused on online ride-hailing drivers (GOJEK, Grab, Maxim, InDrive). Monorepo with Next.js 15 frontend and NestJS backend, Prisma ORM with MySQL/SQLite, full business flow from registration to rental completion.
